dedupe_keys.name: myhospitals data api australian hospital performance measures

description: The MyHospitals Data API gives programmatic access to the Australian Institute of Health and Welfare's MyHospitals hospital performance data. The producer is the Australian Institute of Health and Welfare. Coverage is national: 1,428 hospital reporting units with coordinates, flags for closed and private hospitals, and mappings to local hospital networks, primary health networks and states, plus peer groups and national totals. Twelve measure categories cover admissions, emergency department presentations, time in the emergency department and waiting times, elective surgery, length of stay, cancer, hand hygiene, bloodstream infections, financial performance and specialised services, each with data items by hospital and reporting period, caveats and suppression codes. The data are available free through a REST API returning JSON, documented with an OpenAPI specification, with flat extracts and downloads; the specification states a Creative Commons BY 3.0 licence. Caveats: measures differ in period and coverage, small values are suppressed, private hospitals report fewer measures, and the AIHW website itself blocked this environment, so terms were read from the API. Simulation uses: building a national hospital layer with capacity proxies, calibrating emergency department demand and waiting times, and assessing which hospitals are critical in disaster scenarios. Related records: the CMS hospital provider data (data-cms-provider-data-hospitals) are the United States counterpart.
